headline: The Nasdaq Composite index fell to its lowest level since April
summary: The Nasdaq Composite fell 0.74% to 24,328.38, its lowest level since April. The Dow Jones dropped 1.65% to 50,759.42 and the S&P 500 lost 1.03% to 7,340.53.
why: The Nasdaq Composite tracks thousands of US-listed stocks, heavily weighted toward technology. The Dow and S&P 500 are the main benchmarks for US large caps.

impacts.name: Nasdaq Composite
impacts.why: The index itself fell 0.74% to its lowest level since April.
